(Currently amended) A system comprising: a plurality of network nodes of a local contention neighborhood of a random access network, wherein a first node of the plurality is configured to transmit to a second node of the plurality at an access attempt percentage, and wherein each of the plurality of nodes is configured to provide an indicia of its inter-node interference to one or more other nodes of the plurality, and wherein the first node is configured to adjust the access attempt percentage to transmit to the second node based on one of the provided indicia.
